relevance_note: Retrospective VEO-IBD cohort (36 children) whose Table 3 describes two patients individually with TNFAIP3 monogenic findings: "| P22/G1 | M | 48 | 72 | CD | Yes | TNFAIP3 |".
method_note: Read by hand; a short script only assembled the JSON. Scope: only P22/G1 and P23/G1 (Table 3, Gene = TNFAIP3) plus the sibling of P23/G1 ("Sibling died from EBV-HLH.") are in scope; the other 22 Table 3 patients (other genes) and the rest of the 36-child cohort get no rows. Variant descriptions are only in Supplementary Table S2, which is not in the file, so both variant rows have variant_original_string 'not reported' and all variant fields not reported. Pathogenicity left not reported: G1 means 'Monogenic findings', and monogenic disease is defined in Methods as 'pathogenic or likely pathogenic' (two values, not this person's class). Ages are from Table 3 columns T1 (onset) and T2 (diagnosis), in months per the legend. Ethnicity 'Vietnamese' comes from the study-level description of the cohort. Checklist 'recurrent fever' left not reported for both: the table says 'persistent fever', not recurrent. 'weight loss' (P22) was not taken as growth failure. P22's FH = Yes (family history of IBD in a first-degree relative) is about an unnamed relative, so no row was made. The Discussion's group sentence about the two TNFAIP3 patients lists features without saying which patient had which; it was not used to assign features. The sibling of P23/G1 has unknown sex and no reported TNFAIP3 testing. Minor inconsistency: the Table 3 column header is 'FH' but the legend says 'HF: Family history of IBD'. Table 3 cells are not stacked.
